description.en: A delete-style confirmation for revoking an API key, with the outcome reported on the page.
description.zh: 吊销 API 密钥的删除式确认，并在页面上反馈结果。

description.en: The open state lives in the page, so a result message tracks the user's decision.
description.zh: 打开状态由页面持有，因此结果文案能跟随用户的选择。

description.en: An informational alert with an icon, a title, a description and a request action.
description.zh: 带图标、标题、描述与请求操作的信息提示。

description.en: A destructive alert listing failed jobs, with a control that switches to the clean state.
description.zh: 用列表列出失败任务的危险提示，并可切换到全部正常的默认状态。

description.en: Initials fallbacks at the sm, default and lg sizes.
description.zh: sm、default 与 lg 三种尺寸下的姓名缩写回退。

title.en: Avatar group with an overflow count

description.en: Four overlapping avatars plus a count, expandable to the full member list.
description.zh: 四个重叠头像加一个溢出计数，可展开为完整的成员列表。

description.en: All six badge variants in a row, including a badge rendered as a link.
description.zh: 一行展示全部六种徽标变体，其中包括渲染为链接的徽标。

title.en: Status with a dot and an icon

description.en: A status badge that combines a dot, an icon and a variant, driven by a three-way switch.
description.zh: 由三档按钮切换驱动，同时组合圆点、图标与变体的状态徽标。

description.en: The default button, plus the secondary, outline and ghost variants.
description.zh: 默认按钮，以及次要、描边和幽灵三种变体。

title.zh: 图标、纯图标与链接按钮

description.en: Icons compose as children; icon-only buttons need an accessible name, and asChild keeps link semantics.
description.zh: 图标作为子元素组合；纯图标按钮必须提供无障碍名称，asChild 则保留链接语义。

description.en: Three sizes, a disabled button, a destructive action and a spinner composed as a child.
description.zh: 三种尺寸、禁用状态、危险操作，以及把 Spinner 作为子元素组合出的加载态。

description.en: A project card with a status badge, progress and footer actions.
description.zh: 项目卡片：状态徽标、进度条与底部操作。

description.en: A security card with a status badge in CardAction and a footer toggle.
description.zh: 安全设置卡片：CardAction 中放状态徽标，底部放切换操作。

description.en: A single opt-in with a description and a status line that mirrors its state.
description.zh: 单个勾选项，带说明文字以及同步显示状态的提示行。

description.en: Three notification options stored as one controlled array of values.
description.zh: 三个通知选项，值保存在一个受控数组中。

description.en: A controlled range stored as YYYY-MM-DD strings.
description.zh: 以 YYYY-MM-DD 字符串保存的受控范围。

description.en: Quick ranges next to the calendar.
description.zh: 日历旁的快捷范围。

description.en: An invite-member dialog with an email and a role field, plus footer actions.
description.zh: 包含邮箱与角色字段、底部带操作按钮的邀请成员对话框。

description.en: A max-height keeps a long release note inside the dialog and scrolls its body.
description.zh: 用最大高度把较长的发布说明限制在对话框内，并让内容滚动。

description.en: A bottom drawer with draft preferences and explicit save and cancel actions.
description.zh: 底部抽屉：先编辑草稿偏好，再明确保存或取消。

description.en: A rename panel opened with direction="right" and a validated name field.
description.zh: 通过 direction="right" 打开的改名面板，名称字段带校验。

description.en: Edit, duplicate and delete actions, with the destructive item separated at the end.
description.zh: 编辑、复制与删除操作，其中危险项单独分隔在末尾。

title.en: Checkbox items, radio items and a submenu
title.zh: 复选项、单选项与子菜单

description.en: Independent toggles, a single-choice density group and a nested share submenu.
description.zh: 互相独立的开关、单选密度分组，以及嵌套的分享子菜单。

description.en: A react-hook-form form that validates two text fields on submit.
description.zh: 使用 react-hook-form 的表单，在提交时校验两个文本字段。

description.en: A select and a checkbox wired into the same form, with a submitted summary.
description.zh: 把选择器与复选框接入同一个表单，并在提交后显示结果摘要。

description.en: A controlled email field that reports whether the address looks usable.
description.zh: 受控的邮箱输入框，会提示地址是否可用。

description.en: Text, email and password fields, plus a disabled field and an aria-invalid field.
description.zh: 文本、邮箱与密码字段，以及禁用字段和 aria-invalid 字段。

description.en: A label associated with an input through matching htmlFor and id.
description.zh: 通过匹配的 htmlFor 与 id 和输入框建立关联的标签。

description.en: A required field marked with an asterisk and a disabled field with its reason.
description.zh: 用星号标记的必填字段，以及注明原因的禁用字段。

description.en: A TanStack Table instance plus a controlled search field.
description.zh: 一个 TanStack Table 实例，加一个受控搜索框。

description.en: Checkbox selection with a summary bar that clears the selection.
description.zh: 复选框选择，以及可清空选择的汇总栏。

description.en: A controlled billing plan choice where every option carries a one-line hint.
description.zh: 受控的套餐选择，每个选项都带一行说明。

description.en: Three cadence options in one row, with the unavailable one disabled and explained.
description.zh: 一行三个频率选项，其中不可用的一项被禁用并给出说明。

description.en: A controlled role picker that explains the chosen role underneath.
description.zh: 受控的角色选择器，并在下方说明所选角色的权限。

description.en: Grouped permissions with a disabled item, plus a disabled select showing an inherited value.
description.zh: 带禁用项的分组权限，以及展示继承值的禁用选择器。

description.en: Horizontal rules between the sections of an invoice summary.
description.zh: 发票摘要各区块之间的水平分隔线。

title.zh: 工具栏中的垂直分隔线

description.en: A vertical rule that splits the formatting toggles from the clear action.
description.zh: 把格式切换按钮与清除操作分开的垂直分隔线。

description.en: A bottom sheet that collects audit filters before applying them.
description.zh: 从底部滑出、先收集审计筛选条件再应用的抽屉面板。

description.en: A right-side panel that edits a member with inline validation.
description.zh: 从右侧滑出、带行内校验的成员编辑面板。

description.en: A card placeholder that swaps to the loaded card without changing its frame.
description.zh: 在不改变卡片外框的情况下切换为已加载内容的卡片占位。

description.en: Five skeleton rows that become member rows with avatars and status badges.
description.zh: 五行骨架屏，加载后变为带头像与状态徽标的成员列表。

description.en: The small, default and large spinner next to the space each size suits.
description.zh: 小号、默认与大号加载指示器，并标注各自适用的场景。

description.en: A labeled spinner and a LoadingOverlay that covers a card while it refreshes.
description.zh: 带标签的加载指示器，以及刷新时覆盖卡片的 LoadingOverlay。

description.en: A settings row where the switch state is reflected in a status line.
description.zh: 设置行中的开关，其状态会同步显示在状态文案里。

description.en: The default and sm tracks, plus a disabled switch with the reason next to it.
description.zh: 默认与 sm 两种尺寸，以及旁边注明原因的禁用开关。

description.en: A members table with a caption and a search field that filters rows.
description.zh: 带标题和搜索过滤的成员表格。

description.en: An invoice table whose footer total follows a hide-paid toggle.
description.zh: 账单表格，表尾合计随“隐藏已付款”开关变化。

description.en: Account settings split into profile, notification and security panels.
description.zh: 账户设置拆分为资料、通知与安全三个面板。

description.en: A vertical tab list where the billing tab stays disabled until the owner view is on.
description.zh: 垂直标签列表：切换到所有者视图前，账单标签保持禁用。

description.en: A controlled review note with a live character count against the hard limit.
description.zh: 受控的审核备注，并实时显示字符数上限。

description.en: A disabled summary next to a textarea that turns invalid until the reason is long enough.
description.zh: 禁用的处理摘要，以及内容过短时变为无效状态的文本域。

description.en: A text button and an icon-only button, each with a tooltip that opens on hover or focus.
description.zh: 文本按钮与纯图标按钮，各自带有一个悬停或聚焦即打开的文字提示。

description.en: Four triggers that place their tooltip on the top, right, bottom and left.
description.zh: 四个触发器，将文字提示分别放在上、右、下、左四侧。
